Shaam se aankh mein nami si hai
couplets.en: Since dusk, my eyes have been a little damp.

lines: Shaam se aankh mein nami si hai
Aaj phir aap ki kami si hai
couplets.en: My eyes have been a little damp since dusk, and today I miss you again.

lines: Shaam se aankh mein nami si hai
couplets.en: Since dusk, my eyes have been a little damp.

lines: Dafn kar do hamein ke saans mile
couplets.en: Bury me so I can breathe.

lines: Dafn kar do hamein ke saans mile
Nabz kuchh der se thami si hai
couplets.en: Bury me so I can breathe, for my pulse seems to have been still a while.

lines: Nabz kuchh der se thami si hai
couplets.en: My pulse seems to have been still a while.

lines: Aaj phir aap ki kami si hai
Waqt rehta nahin kahin tik kar
couplets.en: Time never stays in one place.

lines: Waqt rehta nahin kahin tik kar
Is ki aadat bhi aadmi si hai
couplets.en: Time never stays in one place, a habit it shares with us.

lines: Is ki aadat bhi aadmi si hai
couplets.en: Time has that human habit too.
